summary: Iteration 49 - Tested performance optimization features: rooms default collapsed, EXPAND ALL/COLLAPSE ALL buttons, floor banners with collapse toggles, and legacy floor migration endpoint. Walkthrough tab fully functional. Checklist and FFE tabs show 'No Rooms Available' because items haven't been synced/transferred yet (expected behavior).
critical_code_review_comments: Walkthrough tab: EXPAND ALL, COLLAPSE ALL, FIX LEGACY FLOORS buttons all working correctly
Floor banners (GARAGE, 1st Floor) visible with collapse toggles (▶/▼)
Rooms default to collapsed state - only floor headers visible on initial load
EXPAND ALL expands all rooms and categories, COLLAPSE ALL collapses them
Room floor selector dropdown working correctly
Checklist/FFE tabs show 'No Rooms Available' when no rooms exist - EXPAND ALL/COLLAPSE ALL buttons only render when rooms exist (expected behavior)
Legacy floor migration endpoint POST /api/projects/{project_id}/migrate-legacy-floors returns 200 with correct response
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 49 verified performance optimization features. Key findings: (1) Walkthrough tab has EXPAND ALL, COLLAPSE ALL, FIX LEGACY FLOORS buttons working correctly, (2) Floor banners (GARAGE, 1st Floor) have collapse toggles, (3) Rooms default to collapsed state on page load, (4) Checklist and FFE tabs show 'No Rooms Available' because items need to be synced/transferred first - this is expected behavior and the EXPAND ALL/COLLAPSE ALL buttons only render when rooms exist, (5) Legacy floor migration endpoint returns 200 with {migrated: 0, removed_room_ids: [], message: 'Migrated 0 legacy floor headers into floor assignments'} when no legacy floors to migrate.
